description: Everything here was placed by someone paying full attention.
looks: Everything here has been put where it is, deliberately, and every decision was correct.
This place has weight. It has been here a long time and it intends to stay.
The light in here is moving onto the right things and taking its time about it.
There is a great deal of significance in this room and none of it is in a hurry.
name: the room, meaning it
